ex-tdmath-pure-state-versus-average-entr.reason: No restriction T>0 is stated, yet the claim holds “for every T.” At T=0, both the Cesàro state and the average instantaneous entropy divide by zero and are undefined. The averaging parameter needs an explicit domain.

lem-tdmath-periodized-empirical-field-st.reason: F3 drops the box-measure theorem’s explicit Axiom of Countable Choice hypothesis. Neither the statement nor supplied premises assumes it, so this citation does not justify the volume normalization used in steps 1.1–2.1.
